03/02/25 2nd appointment.
Follow up appointment with Dr Wong.
She was absolutely wonderful she was extremely knowledgeable about my condition and seemed genuinely kind and understanding, she is a locum GP. She, like all GPs in every practice was running about 30 minutes late but this doesn’t bother me one bit because in my opinion it shows that they are taking the necessary time with patients rather than rushing one in and out as quickly as possible.
Reception staff, I know the administration and reception staff have a hard time when it comes to dealing with the public but I have never had a bad experience, yes it can be frustrating sometimes when one is not well but credit must also be given to these individuals who have a difficult job.
I had gone to the chemist to get my prescription but realised I had forgotten to ask for the other medication I need so I went back to the practice which was technically closed. I spoke to a lovely receptionist who popped an emergency request through to another Dr so I can hopefully collect my other medication tomorrow.
I tried to do it online but apparently there is a limit as to how many patients can submit forms. All in all I think we are lucky to have such a nice practice and staff team. Keep up the good work I STILL APPRECIATE ALL YOU DO! Thank you all!
